# Synthetic test input; never execute as a workflow.
name: partial-body-analysis-fixture
'on': pull_request
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Supported body interpolation
        shell: bash
        run: printf '%s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}"
      - name: Body and an unmodeled expression
        shell: bash
        run: printf '%s\n' "${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}" "${{ toJSON(github.workspace) }}"
